records.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, production 2D street-game whole-body turn artwork.
Image 1 is the exact adult BODY, FACE, AGE, PROPORTIONS, CLOTHES, PAINT AND PROP authority: Hartmut Keller's four cardinal views. Image 2 is his own close portrait, used only for facial identity.
Create ONE horizontal row of FOUR DISTINCT COMPLETE whole-body planted NEUTRAL oblique paintings of the SAME older adult Hartmut, exact left-to-right order: FRONT-RIGHT quarter (body halfway between front and strict screen-right profile), REAR-RIGHT quarter (halfway between screen-right profile and true rear), REAR-LEFT quarter (halfway between true rear and screen-left profile), FRONT-LEFT quarter (halfway between screen-left profile and front). Rotate the whole torso, shoulders, pelvis, trousers and complete shoes together in place. Front quarters must have visibly oblique chest and pelvis, not a frontal body with only a sideways head; rear quarters show his vest back and back of head with partial profile appropriately.
Preserve his older stern angular lined face, high wrinkled forehead, receding messy gray-dark hair, rectangular black glasses, skeptical tired eyes and CLOSED REST LIPS. Olive quilted sleeveless vest, beige long-sleeve button shirt, brown belt, full dark-brown trousers and substantial scuffed brown lace-up work shoes. Preserve exact adult head size, substantial torso/arm/thigh/shin lengths and mature connected proportions of Image1: approximately 937px sole-to-crown if returned1536x1024. Same crown and sole lines across all4. Quiet planted walking-ready stance, separate complete shoes, no stepping or dramatic gesture.
Exactly ONE small black walkie-talkie stays in anatomical RIGHT hand, raised near right chest; anatomical LEFT hand holds ONE black flashlight and ONE cream spiral notepad together against left torso. Front shows radio viewer-left and flashlight/notepad viewer-right; rear reverses screen sides. Right-facing quarters show near right radio hand and physically occlude far left notebook/flashlight appropriately. Left-facing quarters show near left flashlight/notepad hand and farther radio hand. Never mirror or swap objects/hands. Preserve complete anatomical hands and real grips.
Match the mature expressive Disco Elysium-meets-Berlin oil painting: angular weary facial planes, broad dry broken brushwork, muted dirty olive/beige/brown, worn cloth and shoes. Not cute, chibi, glossy3D, anime, smooth doll, tiny head, short body or child Hartmut Maaslos.
Four separate intact figures, generous transparent margins/gutters, all hair/arms/props/shoes inside canvas. GENUINE TRANSPARENT RGBA outside bodies. No brown backdrop from reference, no floor, shadows, glow, halo, text, labels, arrows, grid, extra figures or floating scraps.

No swaps, duplicate equipment, floating objects or missing grips. Complete connected anatomical hands.
Quiet neutral walking-ready stance; both complete shoes planted on one sole plane with modest separation, no step. Preserve closed rest lips.
